# TEST-ONLY fixtures (SPEC-W52 geo-service tests)

Hand-written, tiny, synthetic polygons around a fictitious "Test State
Alpha". These are NOT real administrative boundaries — real imports must use
attributed sources (geoBoundaries CC-BY-4.0 / GRID3, see
docs/geospatial-terrio.md). Coordinates are EPSG:4326 [lng, lat].
